title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (February, 2026)
summary: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central February 2026 cumulative updates are available for versions BC27, BC26, BC25, and BC24, with specific platform and application build numbers for cloud and on-premises deployments. New customers automatically receive BC27.4, while existing customers get email notifications for available updates; BC25 introduces more flexible environment update management with extended major update windows and optional minor updates.
key_points: BC27.4 CU04 released for cloud (SaaS) with platform 27.0.45543.0 and application 27.4.45366.45675
On-premises BC27.4 update available with platform 27.0.45396.0 and application 27.4.45366.45458
BC25 (2024 wave 2) changes major update window from 30-60 days to 5 months and makes minor updates optional
Multiple versions supported with clear lifecycle dates: BC27 (Oct 2025-Apr 2027), BC26 (Apr 2025-Oct 2026), BC25 (Oct 2024-Apr 2026), BC24 end-of-life
Resources available including release plan, partner deck, YouTube videos, Yammer feedback group, and Ask Us Anything Office Hours
features: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in Admin Center
